selection.rule: frontmatter flowchart original whose config map is exactly {htmlLabels: bool}, folded description allowed, body carries a backtick Markdown string, no body init directive
selection.blocker_detection: three fixed source-content detectors (Markdown subgraph title, non-whitelisted config leaf, angle/raw-HTML in span); no generator-time rendering; residual rows abort
selection.width_policy: original track pre-registers the 240-column admission and narrow_40 stays source (the disclosure footer exceeds 40 columns); body track states are recorded in expected_body_states.
